# `sms_send_text_message`

Send an SMS via AWS End User Messaging (SendTextMessage shape); requires msg/sms:send. Supports DryRun.

## Input schema

```json

  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {

        "type": "string"

      "description": "Key/value pairs logged to the event destination",
      "type": "object"

      "description": "Recipient in E.164, e.g. +12065550100; must satisfy the recipient allow-list where configured",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "DryRun": {
      "description": "Validate and run guardrails, return the would-be call without sending",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "MaxPrice": {
      "description": "Per-message USD ceiling; the server caps it at its configured maximum",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "MessageBody": {
      "description": "The text to send",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "MessageType": {
      "description": "TRANSACTIONAL (default) or PROMOTIONAL",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "OriginationIdentity": {
      "description": "Origination number; defaults to the server's toll-free number and must match it",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "TimeToLive": {
      "description": "Seconds the message may spend queued, 5-259200",
      "maximum": 2147483647,
      "minimum": -2147483648,
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "DestinationPhoneNumber",
    "MessageBody"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
